name: Deep-Pressure Compression Vest
short_description: Discreet, adjustable deep-pressure input for focus and self-regulation
description: The CalmWear compression vest applies gentle, even deep-pressure across the torso -- the same calming input as a firm hug -- to help children regulate during transitions, homework, or overstimulating environments. The adjustable side straps fit under regular clothing, so it's discreet enough for the classroom. Machine washable, available in 5 sizes from toddler to teen.
key_features: Adjustable compression, worn under regular clothing
Recommended by occupational therapists for sensory regulation
meta_title: Deep-Pressure Compression Vest for Sensory Regulation

name: TalkPath AAC Communication App
short_description: Speech-generating app license for non-verbal and minimally-verbal communicators
description: TalkPath turns a tablet into a full augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) device, using a customizable picture-and-symbol grid that speaks aloud as a child builds sentences. Vocabulary, grid size, and voice can all be tailored to a child's current communication level and grow with them over time. Many families use TalkPath alongside AAC training from a speech-language pathologist to get the most out of it.
key_features: Customizable symbol grid, scales from single words to full sentences
Natural-sounding text-to-speech voices, including child voices
meta_title: TalkPath AAC App for Non-Verbal Communicators
meta_description: TalkPath is a customizable speech-generating AAC app for non-verbal and minimally-verbal children, with a symbol grid that grows over time.

name: EasyGrip Adaptive Utensil Set
short_description: Weighted, steady-hold utensils that make independent mealtimes easier
description: The EasyGrip set pairs a wide, cushioned handle with a weighted base to reduce tremor and improve control for kids working on fine motor skills at mealtime. The angled spoon and fork heads reduce the wrist rotation needed to eat independently. Dishwasher safe, and the set includes a fork, spoon, and a training knife.
